---
title: "CPW T-junction"
sidebar: get-started
---

`cpw_t_junction` joins a straight CPW trunk to a perpendicular branch. It uses
an OrcaPen CPW cross-section with DRAW, negative and positive ETCH, and
GROUND_MASK sections.

## Build the default component

```python
import gdsfactory as gf
from orcapen_sc_pdk import activate

activate()
component = gf.get_component("cpw_t_junction")
```

## Parameters

| Argument | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `trunk_length` | 200 µm | Length of the straight trunk. |
| `branch_length` | 100 µm | Length of the perpendicular branch. |
| `cross_section` | `coplanar_waveguide` | Cross-section; must include the required OrcaPen CPW sections. |

## Ports and layers

`o1` and `o2` are at the trunk ends; `o_branch` points along +Y. Geometry layers
come from the selected cross-section. See [Cross-sections](../cross-sections.qmd)
for the default recipe.

See the [generated API reference](../../reference/cells.cpw_t_junction.qmd#orcapen_sc_pdk.cells.cpw_t_junction)
and [pinned public source](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/blob/0bd9a9e1e8e21d6519f22373f20ef5ce22772a5b/orcapen_sc_pdk/cells/layout/cpw.py).
